request: The Android app crashes on launch for some users since release 5.2. Most crash reports come from Samsung phones. Is it a device problem or our build?
known_answer: Release 5.2 raised targetSdk to 34; the app registers a runtime broadcast receiver without RECEIVER_EXPORTED or RECEIVER_NOT_EXPORTED, which throws SecurityException on Android 14 only. Samsung dominates simply because most Android 14 users in the crash set are on Samsung.
decoy_answer: A Samsung firmware bug makes the app crash on launch on Samsung phones.
source: synthetic: the cause is fixed by construction in this task's files; no real system or client
